Title likhein
Apne thoughts
Nayi shuruaat karein ya template lein
Public circle join karein
Public circle chunein aur Join dabayein.
List mein public circles milte hain. Practice mein koi asli circle join nahi hota.
Code se join karein
Private circle ke liye Join with code dabayein.
Owner se invite code maangein. Asli screen par join aur create karne ki limits dikhti hain.
Invite code bharein
Chhe akshar ka code bharein, phir Join dabayein.
Yeh sample code hai. Practice mein join request nahi bheji jaati.
Apna circle kholein
Members dekhne ke liye joined circle par tap karein.
Joined circles aapki list mein hain. Andar members, ranks aur live focus status dekhein.
Circle banayein
Apna group banane ke liye Create Circle dabayein.
Asli screen batati hai ki aap circle bana sakte hain ya nahi. Pehle check-in streak chahiye ho sakti hai. Practice kuch nahi banati.
Kaun join kar sakta hai?
Circle ka naam bharein aur Public ya Private chunein.
Public circle sab khoj sakte hain. Private circle ke details mein invite code hota hai. Phir Create dabayein.
Apne members dekhein
Yahan members ka focus time aur rank dekhein.
Connection request ke liye Premium aur acceptance chahiye ho sakti hai. Practice koi request nahi bhejti.
Saath padhein
Ekagra mein circle chunein, phir focus shuru karein.
Focus kar rahe member par live badge dikhta hai. Sirf join karne se timer nahi chalta. Yahan time sample hai.
Apna mood chunein
Jaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain, waisa mood chunein.
Check-in aaj ka mood record karta hai. Practice mood ya streak nahi badalti.
Thoda aur batayein
Intensity chunein aur chahein toh reason ya note likhein.
Slider batata hai ki feeling kitni tez hai. Reason aur note baad mein mood samajhne mein madad karte hain.
Check-in save karein
Taiyar hone par Save Check-in dabayein.
Pehle mood chunein. Asli button check-in save karta hai. Yahan Next sirf sample dikhata hai.
Purane check-ins dekhein
Pichhle moods dekhne ke liye History kholein.
Yahan intensity, note aur date ke saath recent check-ins hain. Yeh entry sample hai.
Ek soch se shuru karein
Koi prompt chunein ya Write dabayein.
Ideas ke liye prompts swipe karein. Bina prompt ke bhi apni baat likh sakte hain.
Apni baat likhein
Title aur thoughts likhein, phir Save Entry dabayein.
Title zaroori nahi hai. Apne din ke baare mein kuch lines likhein. Practice kuch save ya publish nahi karti.
Apni diary padhein
View All dabayein, phir padhne ke liye entry kholein.
Saved entries journal list mein dikhti hain. Yeh sample sirf tutorial mein hai.
Apni streaks dekhein
Daily check-in aur login streaks dekhein.
Streak lagatar active din ginti hai. Eligible hone par hi restore option dikhega.
Active din dekhein
Calendar mein apne active din dekhein.
Marked dates login history se aati hain. Yahan din sample hain.
Apni consistency dekhein
Poore hue goals ka trend chart mein dekhein.
Chart pichhle saat din dikhata hai. Yeh goals badle bina routine samajhne mein madad karta hai.
Ek nazar mein progress
Overview mein apni saari progress dekhein.
Upar ke buttons Goals, Ekagra, Kavach aur Monthly Review kholte hain. Practice mein sample data hai.
Goals ki progress dekhein
Goals mein planned aur completed kaam compare karein.
Goal counts, trends aur study time routine samajhne mein madad karte hain. Yeh goals nahi badalte.
Focus time dekhein
Ekagra mein saved sessions aur time dekhein.
Summary saved Ekagra sessions se aati hai. Practice session shuru ya save nahi karti.
Mahine ka review
Monthly Review kholein aur mahina chunein.
Month controls se reports aur achievements compare karein. Practice asli report nahi banati.
Plan: exam chunein
New Plan se plan banayein ya saved plan kholein.
Is tab mein exam plans hain. Saved plan ke menu mein main options hain. Tutorial sample plan dikhata hai aur detailed setup chhodta hai.
Home: aaj ka kaam
Aaj ke topics, Daily To-do aur add buttons dekhein.
Today aur Done se lists badlein. Poora kaam mark karein ya syllabus se topic jodein. Menu mein plan settings hain. Practice kuch nahi badalti.
Syllabus: topics sambhalein
Chapters aur topics dekhne ke liye subject kholein.
Add aur menu buttons se syllabus sambhalein. Date aur plan controls upar hain. Yeh chhota overview hai.
Calendar: schedule dekhein
Din chun kar uske topics aur revisions dekhein.
Arrows se month badlein. Din kholkar study log dekhein. Practice koi date nahi badalti.
Progress: plan ka haal
Completion, study pace aur exam tak ke din dekhein.
Yeh tab subjects, revisions aur study time ki progress dikhata hai. Naya data bharna zaroori nahi hai.
